card.text: Explore Aschera in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Convex light-curve reconstruction. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: DAMIT 1435 shape model
shape.summary: Convex light-curve reconstruction with approximate thermal size: 26.07 km effective diameter (catalog ±0.34 km; additional shape and thermal-model uncertainty). Thermal size supplies a volume-scale approximation. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative.

elevation.title: DAMIT 1435 radial height
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 13.035 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
